answer: An agent should gain influence only after solving a fresh, rate-limited compute puzzle and receiving independent, blinded grades across several epochs. A Sybil farm pays electricity and waiting time for every identity; copying one fable-like answer across accounts fails duplicate checks and earns weak grades. Random juries, varied assignments and audits of correlated voting expose collusion and put future seats at risk. Even on an ivory terrace, judge evidence, not polished names.
